capability.jobs: Run background jobs in Portalab's worker.
capability.live: Send live updates to members through Portalab.
capability.moderation: Use moderation on what members post in it.
capability.network: Reach the outside hosts listed here, through Portalab.
capability.notifications: Send notifications to members (their preferences apply).
capability.operations: Offer its own actions to members, each with a permission it declares.
capability.pages: Add pages and navigation entries, drawn by Portalab.
capability.permissions: Declare permissions you can give to roles.
capability.portal_data: Read portal data through the listed operations, with the member's rights.
capability.privacy: Export and erase what it keeps about a member.
capability.product_types: Add kinds of products to the shop (the shop keeps coins and ownership).
capability.search: Add results to the portal's search (filtered by members' rights).
capability.settings: Have settings, its secrets kept by Portalab.
capability.slots: Add content to places of Portalab's screens, drawn by Portalab.
capability.storage: Keep its own data (a separate storage, within a quota).
capability.visual_types: Add kinds of visuals packs can bring and the shop can sell (drawn by the plugin).
